summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sixth Supplemental Indenture to issue $750M aggregate principal of 6.150% notes due 2031. The notes are general unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with other unsecured unsubordinated debt and structurally junior to subsidiary liabilities. Interest is payable semi-annually starting December 16, 2026, and the notes mature June 16, 2031. A change of control repurchase event triggers an offer at 100% principal plus accrued interest. This is a routine debt offering with no special-situation M&A, activist, or restructuring elements.
